description: This file defines a singleton object AppRepositories that manages repository instances, specifically a cart repository, providing access to it and a flow for cart item counts within an Android Kotlin project.

methods.name: cart
methods.description: Provides a process-wide singleton instance of CartRepository, initializing it if necessary, and scoped to the application context.

methods.name: cartItemCount
methods.description: Returns a Flow of the total quantity of items in the cart, aggregating data from the CartRepository's items flow.
